data.one_liner: Compresses data to 5x‑40x smaller size with lossless restoration
data.what_it_does: Shrink automatically detects the best compression method for a given String, Map, Uint8List or List<int> and returns a compact representation. The original data can be restored exactly with a single method call.
use_when: Storing large JSON or text locally
avoid_when: Compressing data that is already compressed or random
Using it on binary media that is already lossless
strengths: Automatic method selection and performance optimizations
weaknesses: Adds a byte if data is compressed twice
Not effective on truly random data
data.minimal_example:
final compressed = data.shrink();
final restored = compressed.restoreJson();
